locator.quote: Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent. […] has super-properties: - prov:wasInfluencedBy op […] has domain: - prov:Entity […] has range: - prov:Agent […] can be qualified with: - prov:qualifiedAttribution op - prov:Attribution
